$comment: The AX estate gate (ax-laf) — one scoreboard, one pass/fail for the .ax surfaces. Run: node dist/cli/index.js gate --estate examples/ax-estate.json (or `npx autonomous-qa gate --estate ...`). REQUIRED surfaces must pass their pinned spec or the gate exits non-zero (a failing surface fails the job — honest by design). apis.ax is pinned to its ratified AXP digest so the gate is Goodhart-resistant. api.qa self-grades advisory (no pinned spec). page.ax and apps.ax are 522/403 deployed and are graded PRE-DEPLOY, in-process/local, not from CI against a public URL — see the local-estate examples + the vitest toConform path in docs/ci.md.
